answer: Vouching with slashing: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, signing the endorsement with its key (its quill) and escrowing part of its own stake as an anchor. If clustering later flags the newcomer as a duplicate of an existing operator, both stakes are slashed and the sponsor's reputation drops off a ledge. Each fake thus costs real collateral plus a sponsor's standing, which outweighs one more reward share.
